question: After the death of Humayun, the 13 year-old Akbar was coronated in 1556 at Kalanaur in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

• Humayun was the son of Babur.
 
• Humayun means "fortune" but he remained the most unfortunate ruler of the Mughal Empire.
 
• Sher shah suri became powerful in the east.
 
• Humayun marched against him and in the Battle of Chausa in 1539, Sher Khan destroyed the Mughal army and Humayun fled.
